actual: MA-E19R reproducibility controls produced numerically identical predictions and identical daily ranked Top-K, but different holdings and portfolio returns. Equal-score instruments can be selected differently because stable score sorting preserves non-canonical input order; BUG-1133 removed set iteration but did not define a deterministic secondary instrument key. Require canonical score-desc/instrument-asc tie handling, permutation and fresh-process replay tests, and no change to non-tied business ordering.
